jobs.title: Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met cloud\-native architecturen en integratieoplossingen? Ben jij degene die technische uitdagingen aangaat en deze vertaalt in praktische en schaalbare toepassingen? Wil jij jouw (AI) kennis inzetten om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren? Dan zoeken wij jou als Integration Software Developer binnen ons Integratie Team bij Rensa Family Company.


Rensa Family Company is een groeiende organisatie binnen de technische groothandel waar efficiëntie en innovatie centraal staan. Als Software Developer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van ons Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP). Dit platform speelt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van onze IT\-systemen en het ondersteunen van onze bedrijfsprocessen.


Jouw expertise en visie zorgen ervoor dat we ons integratielandschap moderniseren en toekomstbestendig maken. Samen met het team ontwikkel je oplossingen voor complexe IT\-vraagstukken en help je onze organisatie verder te digitaliseren.

**Wat doet het Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP)?**


Het Hybrid Integration Platform is ontworpen om applicaties op een gestandaardiseerde, schaalbare en onderhoudbare manier te integreren. Het biedt een cloud\-native foundation die zowel cloud\-based als on\-premise systemen bindt in een event\-driven architectuur.


Met technologieën zoals Azure Service Bus, Docker, ASP.NET Core Web API en Azure Functions, helpt HIP ons om integratiecomplexiteit te verminderen, ontwikkelingscycli te versnellen en flexibele samenwerking tussen onze systemen mogelijk te maken.

**Jouw rol als Engineer**


Als Integration Software Engineer draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor:

* Ontwerp en ontwikkeling: Het ontwerpen, realiseren en optimaliseren van HIP\-componenten zoals adapters, services en event\-driven messaging.
* Samenwerking binnen het team: Je werkt nauw samen met collega\-developers, architecten en andere stakeholders om kwalitatieve integratieoplossingen te realiseren.
* Standaardisatie en kwaliteit: Je ontwikkelt oplossingen volgens de geldende integratiestandaarden, waaronder het gebruik van het Rensa Data Model (RDM) en Canonical Data Models.
* Samenwerking met business en IT\-stakeholders: Je vertaalt zakelijke behoeften naar technische oplossingen en werkt samen aan het verbeteren van processen en technologieën
* Continue verbetering: Je blijft op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen binnen integratie\- en cloudtechnologieën en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen en ontwikkelprocessen.
* Toepassen van AI: Je zet AI\-tools in om ontwikkeling, testen, documentatie en analyse van integratieoplossingen efficiënter en kwalitatief beter uit te voeren.
* Testen en beheer: Je bent betrokken bij het testen, documenteren, monitoren en onderhouden van integratieoplossingen om een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening te waarborgen.

**Technologieën waarmee je gaat werken**

* .NET (C\#)
* Azure Service Bus
* Azure API Management
* Azure Functions
* ASP.NET Web API
* Azure CosmosDB
* Azure Storage\-accounts
* Azure SQL
* Azure Container Apps
* Docker (en Kubernetes via Azure Container Apps Environment)
* KEDA voor event\-driven autoscaling
* Azure DevOps
* AI tooling: GitHub, Copilot, chatGPT, Codex etc.

**Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat om ons team te versterken?**

* (Ruime) ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur in .NET (C\#);
* Ervaring met het Azure platform en Azure Services zoals Service Bus, API Management, CosmosDB, Storage Accounts en Functions;
* Het begrijpen en toepassen van containertechnologieën (bijv. Docker) en cloud\-native principes;
* Kennis van event\-driven architecturen en publish/subscribe messaging;
* Ervaring met het implementeren en beheren van RESTful APIs en API\-gateways.
* In staat om effectief samen te werken binnen een multidisciplinair ontwikkelteam en kennis te delen met collega’s.
* Leergierig en continu gericht op het verbeteren van kennis en codekwaliteit.

**Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?**


Wij bieden wij een heel mooi pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Salaris tussen de €4\.000,\- en €5\.500,\- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
* 40 vrije dagen op fulltime basis, waarvan 28 vakantiedagen en 12 verlofdagen;
* Een innovatieve werkomgeving waar jouw ideeën en technische expertise gewaardeerd worden.
* Een organisatie met een visie en focus op duurzaamheid en lange termijn impact;
* Vooroplopen in je vak. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologie, samenwerken met sterke partners en ervaren collega’s;
* Goede verhouding tussen thuiswerken en op kantoor;
* Deelname aan een target\- en winstregeling;
* Een premievrije pensioenregeling met mogelijkheid zelf extra bij te sparen;
* Fijne werksfeer met betrokken collega’s, leuke teamactiviteiten en een actieve personeelsvereniging – work hard, have fun! “We have fun working together” staat niet voor niets in onze strategie.
* Sterke laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
* Tegemoetkoming reiskosten woon\-werkverkeer van € 0\.25 per kilometer.

**Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.**


Werken onder de paraplu van Rensa Family betekent samen met je collega’s bouwen aan stabiele groei. We willen samen met jou de beste partner van de installateur zijn op het gebied van expertise, technisch advies en logistiek. Je krijgt alle ruimte voor persoonlijke groei, ontwikkeling en welzijn. Zodat je trots kunt zijn op je werk, jezelf en je team: samen naar steeds betere, duurzame resultaten! Voor jou als talent of professional en voor Rensa Family als bedrijf. Word wat je wilt, blijf gewoon jezelf. Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.

jobs.description:
* Den Bosch

* ### **Wat ga je doen?**

#### **Met jouw energie kan het**


	+ Jij leidt als manager de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg en daarmee lever je een cruciale bijdrage aan de energietransitie in Brabant.
	+ Je bent een ervaren "senior" manager, die eigenaarschap combineert met samenwerken. Je bent de motor achter de productie, resultaatgericht en vernieuwend.
	+ Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een persoonlijk budget en de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen.
Ben jij een ervaren manager die uitblinkt in het uitzetten en bewaken van een duidelijke koers, sterk is in het creëren van verbinding én gevoel heeft voor samenwerking en ontwikkeling? Ben jij toe aan jouw volgende stap richting senior management niveau? Enexis zoekt een afdelingsmanager Engineering \& Aanleg voor de vestiging Brabant Noordoost in Den Bosch!

#### **Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan**


De energietransitie zorgt ervoor dat de netbeheerders de komende decennia een enorm werkpakket hebben. Ons motto voor de komende jaren is simpel: bouwen, bouwen, bouwen. We moeten hiervoor al onze beschikbare mensen inzetten, zowel intern als bij onze samenwerkingspartners. Tegelijkertijd is de uitdaging voldoende mensen op te leiden en te ontwikkelen tot vakbekwame collega’s én is veilig werken essentieel. Dit vraagt om duidelijke visie en scherpe keuzes, feeling met de werkvloer en creativiteit. Spreekt je dit aan, reageer dan!


Jouw belangrijkste speerpunten in de functie manager Engineering \& Aanleg


De vestiging Brabant Noordoost in Den Bosch is één van de tien regionale vestigingen binnen het werkgebied van Enexis. De vestiging bestaat uit ongeveer 300 collega’s en samen met de vestigingsmanager, de manager Realisatie en de manager Work Force Management vorm je het MT van de vestiging. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. In deze uitdagende rol geef jij direct sturing aan een team van 3 teammanagers en indirect aan ongeveer 60 collega’s die actief zijn binnen de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. Daarnaast geef je indirect sturing aan minstens zoveel collega’s van de contractpartners.


Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het gehele werkpakket voor de ontwikkeling en aanleg van energienetten (gas en elektra) binnen het verzorgingsgebied Brabant Noordoost (jaarlijkse omvang meer dan 80 miljoen euro). We zitten midden in de energietransitie. Het werkpakket groeit en geen dag is hetzelfde. Als afdelingsmanager heb je daardoor veel ballen in de lucht te houden. Met jouw eerdere ervaringen als manager en jouw verandervermogen geef je leiding en richting aan de resultaten en ontwikkeling van de afdeling.


Je zorgt samen met je teammanagers en medewerkers dat de doelstellingen worden behaald. Je stimuleert continue verbetering waarbij werkplezier het uitgangspunt is. Daarnaast zoek je actief de samenwerking op met verschillende afdelingen binnen Enexis en met onze partners extern. Goed stakeholder management is dan ook echt belangrijk voor zowel intern als extern in de markt. Je stuurt op prestaties en bewaakt de kwaliteit van het te leveren werk van jouw afdeling, de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. Jij rapporteert hierover aan de vestigingsmanager. Door jouw rol in het lokale MT neem jij samen met collega MT leden besluiten over de richting en uitvoering van de strategische thema’s. Deze draag je op doel\- en actiegerichte wijze uit binnen de organisatie met oog voor de mens én het collectief.
* ### **Functie\-eisen**

#### **Zo pak jij het aan**


We zoeken een ervaren, inspirerende en doelgerichte manager die knopen durft door te hakken, energie heeft en ook rust en structuur brengt. Iemand die toe is aan zijn volgende management rol. Je beschikt over minimaal een HBO/academisch werk\- en denkniveau en hebt meer dan 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring op vergelijkbaar niveau.


Deze rol vraagt niet alleen *om teamontwikkeling*, maar ook om inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Je hebt een grote affiniteit met operationele processen en ervaring in een technische werkomgeving. Je benadert zaken vanuit verschillende perspectieven en bent positief met een oplossingsgerichte mindset. Verder heb jij ervaring met stakeholders in de organisatie maar ook vooral erbuiten en weet jij als geen ander om betrokken partijen bij elkaar te brengen.
* ### **Team \& cultuur**

#### **Je zet je schouders eronder met...**


Op de vestiging in Den Bosch heerst een informele en professionele sfeer. We stellen de ontwikkeling en veiligheid van onze medewerkers voorop. Door de uitdagingen van de energietransitie nemen we doorlopende nieuwe collega’s aan. We leiden onze collega’s en samenwerkingspartners veelal zelf op wat zorgt voor mooie kansen maar ook voor de nodige uitdagingen op gebied van begeleiding en het verzetten van ons werkpakket. Onze uitdagende strategie kunnen we alleen realiseren met versnelling op het juiste gedrag en leiderschap. We versterken elkaar met onze drie kernwaarden Duidelijk, Inclusief en Lerend.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.
* ### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

#### **En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou**


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en \-programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

**Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director – AI Innovation Teams**


Fitch Ratings is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our new AI Innovation teams in Manchester—a bold initiative building the AI\-powered future of financial analysis. We're not fine\-tuning existing models or optimizing yesterday's algorithms. We're architecting the next generation: sophisticated agentic AI systems, intelligent automation that thinks, and ML capabilities that will redefine how credit analysis happens and how global financial markets consume insights.


This is AI's moment at Fitch, and we're moving decisively. We have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and we're establishing Toronto as our AI innovation center. As a Lead ML Engineer, you'll be a technical champion driving this transformation—building breakthrough ML systems that others will study, mentoring engineers who will become tomorrow's AI leaders, and establishing patterns that will scale across the organization. You're joining at the perfect inflection point: early enough to architect foundational decisions, resourced enough to execute boldly.


We need ML technologists who see greenfield opportunities as fuel rather than fear—whether you're an ML architect ready to design intelligent systems from first principles, an AI engineering leader who translates research breakthroughs into production reality, or a seasoned practitioner who recognizes that this moment demands courage over caution. If you're motivated by "let's prove this is possible" rather than "we need more data before we decide," this is a high\-impact role where you'll spend less time justifying AI's potential and more time realizing it—alongside exceptional engineers who share your conviction that we're building something significant.


This role is ideal for someone who wants to remain deeply hands\-on while operating at a senior level. You will contribute technical expertise, influence decision\-making through strong engineering judgment, and partner closely with engineering leaders, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale. *This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities*


**What We Offer:**


* **Ground\-floor ML leadership with enterprise resources** – Define the ML architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for Fitch's AI future while having the compute, research budgets, and organizational backing that most AI startups would envy; mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on with the most challenging technical problems
* **Build breakthrough ML systems that matter** – Develop net\-new generative AI platforms, multi\-agent orchestration systems, and intelligent automation that will process billions in credit decisions; experiment with frontier models, novel architectures, and unconventional approaches; see your ML innovations directly impact how global financial markets operate
* **Access to cutting\-edge ML infrastructure and research** – Work with the latest LLMs, fine\-tune foundation models, leverage enterprise\-scale GPU clusters, experiment with emerging frameworks before they're mainstream, and collaborate with academic ML researchers; substantial conference and training budgets to stay at the forefront of AI innovation
* **Shape ML governance and standards for an organization** – Establish the ML engineering practices, model governance frameworks, and AI integration patterns that will guide Fitch's AI transformation; your architectural decisions will influence how a global financial services leader approaches intelligent systems
* **Real production impact with sophisticated ML challenges** – Build ML systems that analysts and financial professionals actually use daily; solve hard problems at the intersection of NLP, document intelligence, reasoning systems, and production\-scale deployment; measure your impact in both model performance and business outcomes
* **Accelerated career trajectory in AI leadership** – High visibility to C\-suite executives making billion\-dollar strategic decisions; clear advancement paths to Principal ML Architect or AI Research Lead roles; opportunity to establish yourself as a recognized voice in financial AI and earn a reputation that opens doors across the industry

**We'll Count on You To:**


* **Build transformative ML systems from the ground up** – Design and architect net\-new generative AI solutions, agentic workflows, and intelligent platforms using advanced ML frameworks (PyTorch, etc.), large language models, and emerging AI technologies that fundamentally change how analysts work and how Fitch operates
* **Drive breakthrough AI innovation and experimentation boldly** – Lead exploration of generative AI, multi\-agent systems, RAG architectures, model fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and other emerging ML technologies; create cutting\-edge proofs\-of\-concept; evaluate what's transformative versus what's hype; and turn research into production\-quality AI capabilities
* **Define ML technical vision and architecture for the future** – Shape architectural decisions for ML systems, establish ML engineering standards, drive technology and framework choices, and influence how Fitch approaches intelligent platforms and AI governance across the organization
* **Lead through innovation, influence, and mentorship** – Mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while partnering with product squads, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to translate ambitious AI ideas into elegant technical solutions; foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and calculated risk\-taking
* **Champion ML excellence while moving fast** – Balance innovation velocity with ML engineering best practices; implement robust CI/CD pipelines for ML systems; develop scalable APIs (FastAPI, etc.) for model deployment; solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and production systems; and build solutions that are both breakthrough and reliable
* **Drive ML governance and operational excellence** – Ensure adherence to AI/ML governance guidelines, monitor SLAs for AI solutions, optimize model performance and reliability, and translate complex ML concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences across distributed teams
* **Shape team culture and technical direction** – Help define how our AI innovation teams operate, what "good" looks like for ML engineering, and how we balance exploration with delivery; model the curiosity, boldness, and technical rigor needed to succeed in a greenfield ML innovation environment

**What You Need to Have:**


* **Deep ML technical expertise** – 12\+ years of professional experience building production AI/ML systems, with strong proficiency in Python, ML algorithms (from classical techniques to deep learning), and modern ML frameworks; proven track record of delivering advanced generative AI and ML solutions
* **ML architectural mastery and greenfield experience** – Demonstrated experience designing scalable ML systems from scratch; deep understanding of ML system architecture, model deployment patterns, and the ability to make bold architectural decisions for AI platforms in ambiguous environments
* **Advanced generative AI expertise** – Extensive hands\-on experience developing and integrating generative AI solutions, working with large language models, building agentic systems, implementing RAG architectures, and training/fine\-tuning neural networks using frameworks like PyTorch
* **Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field**
* **Production ML engineering excellence** – Deep understanding of ML operations, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), workflow orchestration (Airflow), automated testing for ML systems, and API development for model deployment

**Job Summary**


Forward Deployed Engineers take a defined use case from nothing to a working, production\-grade system inside the customer's environment. That starts with knowing our platform deeply enough to combine its capabilities into solutions more complex than any single feature was designed for \- and where a customer's specific needs call for something beyond the standard functionality, building that missing piece themselves. This is the role that builds the use case: not a prototype handed to someone else to production, but the system that goes live.


This is a customer\-facing role. Understanding the customer's needs and the realistic possibilities of their technical environment \- and working in close, daily collaboration with them \- is what makes a deployment succeed. We're in daily working contact with the customer's engineers and executives, mostly online, with our team and theirs operating as one delivery unit with shared planning. Success is measured on the customer's numbers \- resolution rate, containment, response latency, CSAT, cost per contact \- and accountability continues past go\-live.


Forward Deployed Engineering brings together two disciplines that used to sit apart: conversation design and integration engineering. An engineer who can build the technical logic behind a scenario; a conversation designer who can design the flow of the conversation itself \- that is what an FDE is. We hire people who are genuinely strong in one of the two and want to grow the other \- expert in both is a direction of travel, not an entry bar. The role is based in Prague and is part of a global function with teams in EMEA and North America.


Please note this is a hybrid role with significant customer on\-site availability required.


**Responsibilities**

* Own the solution design: translate a stated business problem into a technical architecture that fits the customer’s actual processes, constraints and systems.
* Build the agent 01: design, build and iterate the first working version end to end \- the system that goes into production, not a hand\-off.
* Close product gaps: build the custom extensions, integrations, services and tooling the deployment requires, without waiting for core roadmap prioritization.
* Own the integration surface: systems of record, contact channels and data flows \- and, for voice deployments, the telephony path from carrier to agent.
* Evaluate, iterate, improve: define the workflow\-specific tests that determine whether this deployment actually works, and iterate against real traffic until the numbers move.
* Work as the customer’s technical counterpart: deploy alongside their engineers, monitor against the agreed KPIs, tune, and stay accountable past go\-live.
* Feed the platform: capture what you built as a reusable pattern and push recurring patterns toward the core product \- the field is our sensing arm.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\+ years building and shipping software in a customer\-facing role \- solutions or forward\-deployed engineering, professional services delivery, integration engineering, or product engineering with direct customer exposure.
* Genuine depth in at least one of our two disciplines, and the appetite to grow the other: conversation and agent design (dialogue logic, prompting, flows, evaluation) or integration engineering (APIs, services, systems of record, data flows).

**Preferred Experience**

About This Role

Your team

Preqin, part of BlackRock, is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer (Associate) to join the London Engineering team. The team develops and supports technology solutions that power Preqin's private markets platform, helping clients access high-quality data, analytics, and workflow capabilities globally. You will work with a collaborative, international engineering team focused on delivering scalable, cloud-first solutions while applying modern software engineering practices across the full product lifecycle.

Your role and impact

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and support of critical Preqin products. This role offers the opportunity to work across both backend and frontend technologies, with a particular emphasis on building robust services using Python and .NET alongside modern React-based user experiences. You will help drive engineering excellence, contribute to architectural decisions, and support the evolution of products that serve a global client base in the private markets industry.

Your Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

Build new features end-to-end, from concept and design through production deployment and support.
Develop and maintain scalable backend services using Python and .NET, and create intuitive frontend experiences using React and TypeScript.
Take ownership of components within a Software as a Service (SaaS) platform, including production monitoring, operational support, and incident resolution in cloud environments.
Apply information security principles throughout software design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
Contribute to engineering excellence through Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions that meet client and business needs.
Contribute to the design and evolution of cloud-native, distributed systems and modern application architectures.

Your Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Organizational Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated experience developing backend applications with Python and .NET, together with frontend development using modern frameworks such as React and TypeScript.
Strong understanding of software engineering principles, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, and best practices, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
Experience designing, building, and integrating APIs using Representational State Transfer (REST), gRPC, and modern microservices-based architectures.
Experience working within existing codebases and contributing to the deployment of cloud-native applications.
Strong communication skills in English and an interest in understanding business and product domains; experience in financial services is beneficial.
Familiarity with data technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, and Snowflake.

Nice to have

Experience with Java development.
Experience with GraphQL APIs and application integrations.
Exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Familiarity with enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling.
Familiarity with modern DevOps practices and cloud-native engineering approaches.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
